proposed_fixes.title: Avoid consuming Quick Accent input when its bar is hidden
proposed_fixes.root_cause: When a game prevents the Quick Accent overlay, the keyboard hook may still intercept trigger/navigation input.
plan: Trace hook and overlay lifecycle in a game where the bar does not render.
Tie input consumption to confirmed toolbar visibility or cancel the gesture if rendering fails.
Add regression coverage that input is not swallowed when display fails.
